title: Groups
mineEmpty: You are not in any group yet. Create one or ask to join a public group.
publicEmpty: There are no public groups yet.
publicNoMatch: No public group matches your search.

visibilityHint.public: Anyone can find the group, see its name and totals, and ask to join. Members and hikes stay visible to members only.
visibilityHint.private: Only members can see the group. People join by invitation.

summary.title: Group totals
summary.unavailable: The totals are not available right now.

join.title: Join this group
join.pending: Your request is waiting for an admin's decision.

members.title: Members
members.removeWarning: Remove {{name}} from the group? Their past hikes stay, and they stay listed as attendees.

guests.title: Guests
guests.hint: People without an account, known only by a nickname. They can be added to group hikes.
guests.removeWarning: Remove {{name}}? They will also be removed as an attendee from all hikes they took part in, and from the group's statistics. This cannot be undone.

invitations.title: Invite by e-mail
invitations.resent: A new link was sent. The previous one no longer works.
invitations.revokeWarning: The link in the e-mail will stop working.

danger.title: Leave or delete
danger.leaveWarningPublic: You will see only the group's name and totals, and will have to ask to join again. Your past hikes and your trails stay.
danger.leaveWarningPrivate: You will no longer see this group, and can return only with a new invitation. Your past hikes and your trails stay.
danger.deleteHikes: Group hikes stay in the personal statistics of the users who attended, no longer linked to a group. Hikes attended only by guests are deleted.
danger.deleteGuests: All guests are removed, along with their attendance on hikes.
danger.deleteTrails: Trails shared with the group stay with their creators and become private. If the creator already has a private trail with the same name, the group's name is added to it.
danger.deleteMembers: Members and pending invitations and requests are removed.

invitation.title: Group invitation
invitation.fromInviter: {{inviter}} invited you to join the group {{group}}.
invitation.toGroup: You are invited to join the group {{group}}.
invitation.wrongAccount: This invitation was sent to a different e-mail address, or your address has not been verified. Sign in with the address that received it.

errors.not_found: This group does not exist or you cannot see it.

errors.group_name_too_long: The name is too long. It can have at most 100 characters.

errors.visibility_required: Choose who can see the group.

errors.guest_name_taken: This group already has a guest with this nickname.

errors.already_member: This person is already a member of the group.

errors.invitation_not_pending: This invitation is no longer pending.
errors.invitation_not_found: This invitation link is not valid. If you got a newer e-mail, use the link in that one.
errors.invitation_expired: This invitation has expired. Ask the group's admin to send a new one.
errors.invitation_already_used: This invitation has already been used.
errors.invitation_email_mismatch: This invitation was sent to a different e-mail address. Sign in with the address that received it.
errors.email_failed: The e-mail could not be sent, so nothing has changed. Please try again later.
